commands:
for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto --dport ssh -j f2b-a
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-a
<iptables> -X f2b-a

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto --dport ssh -j f2b-a
done; done

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -m multiport --dports ssh -j f2b-b
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-b
<iptables> -X f2b-b

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -m multiport --dports ssh -j f2b-b
done; done
^\s*\S+ system,error,critical login failure for user <F-USER>.*?</F-USER> from <ADDR> via \S+$

files.jail.local:
[routeros-auth]
enabled = true
logpath = /nonexistent/%(__name__)s.log
action = hostsdeny
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=ddos]
[squirrelmail]
enabled = true
backend = auto
maxretry =  3 
bantime = 10m
action = iptables[name=a]
           iptables-multiport[name=b, port=ssh]

stderr:
fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING Have not found any log file for 'squirrelmail' jail.
fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING Have not found any log file for 'routeros-auth' jail.
